description: This PHP source file defines the Upgrade18 class, a controller for handling upgrade process (specifically version 18) in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It contains logic for initializing menu items during the upgrade, querying the database, and creating new menu entries if necessary.

classes.name: Upgrade18
classes.description: Controller class responsible for executing upgrade step 18, which includes menu setup and database modifications.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that performs upgrade logic: loads language, checks existing menu entries, inserts new menu items if needed, and generates JSON response with the next upgrade URL.
